$comment: Every value that exists ONLY in a hosting dashboard, in one file, so moving
servers (or losing a browser session) does not lose the app. This file lists
names and purposes — NEVER the values themselves: it is committed, and a
secret in git is not a secret. `npm run live:check` proves this list still
matches render.yaml and that the live services agree with each other.
Adding an env var to render.yaml without adding it here FAILS that check.
goesWithTheCode: All source in apps/ and packages/, built by the workspaces on install.
schema.prisma and prisma/migrations/, applied in order by `prisma migrate deploy` on boot.
apps/api/data/bible/kjv.json — committed on purpose. Without it the production API has no Bible, and a build-time download would make every deploy depend on 66 fetches to another company's server.
render.yaml — the whole Render topology, so a new Render account can be created from the repo.
.github/workflows/ — CI, and the cron that wakes the jobs service.
Feature switches, roles, RLS policies and seed scripts: they live in code and in the database, not in a dashboard.

mustBeCopiedByHand.breaksWithout: Nothing works — members, giving, attendance, SMS log and audit trail are all here. This is the one thing git cannot carry: it is DATA, not config.
mustBeCopiedByHand.howToMove: Do not recreate. Point the new server at the same Neon project, or use Neon's branch/migrate to copy the dataset. Keep the pooled URL.

mustBeCopiedByHand.breaksWithout: the API answers nothing; every login and page fails
migrations cannot run on boot, so a schema change never lands

mustBeCopiedByHand.livesIn: Neon string for the platform (BYPASSRLS) role
mustBeCopiedByHand.breaksWithout: cross-tenant reads (platform admin, webhooks) return nothing under FORCE RLS
CORS rejects the staff app, and receipt/followup links point at the wrong site

mustBeCopiedByHand.livesIn: Vercel → Project → Settings → Environment Variables (and Render for the chms-web backup)
mustBeCopiedByHand.breaksWithout: Two different failures. On Render the build FAILS LOUDLY (next.config.mjs refuses). On Vercel it builds green and every button 404s, because NEXT_PUBLIC_* is baked into the browser bundle at build time — so changing it needs a redeploy, not a restart.
mustBeCopiedByHand.history: This value once disappeared from the Render dashboard and the staff app went blank. That is why live:check greps the deployed JS chunks.

mustBeCopiedByHand.breaksWithout: no job can read a single row
the nightly scans are cross-tenant; without this role they fall back to app_user and find zero churches, so the reconcile reports a clean night it never did
SMS links in receipts and followups go to the wrong address

mustBeCopiedByHand.livesIn: Render dashboard ONLY, plus the identical value as a GitHub repository secret of the same name
mustBeCopiedByHand.breaksWithout: every /tick answers 401 and no scheduled job ever runs. Deliberately fail-closed: a service created without it cannot send SMS.
mustBeCopiedByHand.note: Two places, one string. Change it in Render and GitHub in the same minute, or the cron gets 401s between the two.

mustBeCopiedByHand.livesIn: github.com → repo → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions
mustBeCopiedByHand.breaksWithout: the cron cannot wake the jobs service

regeneratedAutomatically.note: render.yaml says generateValue, so a NEW Render service invents a different one. Consequence of moving: every signed-out user has to log in again. Not data loss, but tell people.
same — generated per service. Anything that referenced the old value (a provider webhook) must be re-pointed.

generated, and allowed to differ from chms-api's because no worker code reads or checks it today. If the worker ever verifies an API-issued token, this becomes a must-copy value — see the comment in render.yaml.

notSecretsButEasyToLose: The Render service URLs themselves (chms-api-lfox...) are part of allow-lists and of the baked Vercel bundle. Keeping the same service names keeps the same hostnames on a new Render account; renaming means updating NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL and redeploying.
Render free Redis (chms-redis) has ipAllowList [] — reachable only from inside Render. That is why jobs run inside a Render service and not from a GitHub Actions runner: the runner cannot reach it.

Vercel project 'church-management' is wired to this repo and branch; the two abandoned duplicates are not. A new project must point at main, and old ones should be deleted so a push cannot look 'failed' because of a dead project.

Render's whole free workspace shares 750 instance hours a month. A jobs service poked every 5 minutes stays awake forever and uses the quota by itself, suspending the API and the app. That is why the cron fires ten times a day — see jobs-tick.yml.
The live SMS gateway is a database row (PlatformSetting 'sms_gateway'), not an env var: env is only the fallback. Moving servers does not lose it, but restoring a database backup does change it.

checks.what: the API answers and its database is reachable
a Bible bundle is actually present in production
the API accepts the web origin, so the staff app is not silently blocked
the JS the browser downloads points at the live API host (catches a rebuilt-but-stale or emptied NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL)
the jobs service is up and states honestly what it is still missing
a tick without the token is refused
every value render.yaml waits for is written down here
